packageRules.description: Move caret ranges up with each update instead of pinning, so package.json and the pnpm catalog show what's installed.
Majors wait on the Dependency Dashboard. Tick one when you're ready for the migration.
Better Auth can change its database schema in a minor, so its minors wait for a tick too and land on their own.
Svelte, SvelteKit and the Svelte tooling only cross a major together.
Kubb's plugins publish from two repos, so the kubb monorepo group misses some. The generated client needs every @kubb package on one major.
drizzle-kit has to match the drizzle-orm release it writes migrations for.
Capacitor owns the native projects. cap sync rewrites these files, and their Gradle and Swift versions move with Capacitor upgrades.

customManagers.description: git-cliff runs through pnpm dlx in the release workflow, where no built-in manager sees it.
